title: LaMa
hero_prompt: Old-master ink-and-wash drawing on paper, flat and graphic with visible brush and paper texture, not a photograph, not a 3D render, no depth-of-field: a long faded fresco of a garden arcade, a row of painted arches with climbing vines and flowers, and in the middle one large jagged-edged patch where the old plaster was lost has been freshly repainted, its colours a little brighter, the arches and vines continuing unbroken straight through it so the eye barely finds the repair. Warm umber, ochre, sage green and faded terracotta washes.
icon_prompt: A bold, high-contrast emblem of a jagged hole shape being closed by a single thick trowel stroke — stark black-on-white silhouette, no fine crosshatching, reading clearly as a small mark.
